relations.note: Nephthys gathers and heals the king’s limbs in her identity as Seshat.
Some later theological traditions describe Seshat as Thoth’s sister.
Some later theological traditions describe Seshat as Thoth’s daughter.
Some later theological traditions describe Seshat as Thoth’s wife.
Seshat and Thoth record the imported wealth of Hatshepsut’s Punt expedition.
Seshat and Thoth inscribe royal names, reigns, and jubilees on the sacred tree.
Seshat writes the royal name or years on the sacred tree while Atum presides.
Seshat records the royal eternity authorized or supplied by the solar deity.

relations.note: Seshat measures Amun’s temple and records divinely sanctioned building acts and reign.

relations.note: Horus participates in some foundation reliefs while Seshat stretches the measuring cord.
Dendera theology calls Isis Great Seshat and assigns her Seshat’s writing and archival offices.
